questions.q: The Governor of an Indian State is appointed by:
opts: Chief Justice of the Supreme Court
questions.expl: The Governor of a State is appointed by the President of India (Article 155).

questions.q: Which one of the following ports is not in Pakistan?
questions.expl: Bandar Abbas is a strategic port city in southern Iran on the Persian Gulf.

questions.q: The capital of Australia is:
questions.expl: Canberra is the federal capital of Australia.

questions.q: Which state criticised India for the abrogation of Article 370 of the Indian Constitution?
questions.expl: Turkey publicly criticised India over the revocation of Article 370 in 2019.

questions.q: In which year did India host the Commonwealth Games?
questions.expl: The XIX Commonwealth Games were hosted by Delhi in October 2010.

questions.q: The 2020 Summer Olympic Games were scheduled to be held in:
questions.expl: Tokyo was the host city for the 2020 Olympic Games (held in 2021 due to COVID-19).

questions.q: Who among the following Nobel laureates did not have any significant connection with Kolkata?
questions.expl: Har Gobind Khorana was born in Punjab and studied in Lahore and England, having no major link to Kolkata.

questions.q: Which one of the following states is not a member of BIMSTEC?
questions.expl: Pakistan is not a member of BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation).

questions.q: Keshav Maharaj is a cricketer who plays for:
questions.expl: Keshav Maharaj is a South African international cricketer who bowls left-arm spin.

questions.q: Who was the first President of the Indian National Congress?
questions.expl: W. C. Bonnerjee presided over the first INC session at Bombay in December 1885.

questions.q: Who was the Governor of Jammu and Kashmir in 2019?
questions.expl: Satya Pal Malik served as Governor of J&K during the abrogation of Article 370 in August 2019.

questions.q: Which sports-person and game are correctly matched?
questions.expl: Simona Halep is a Romanian former world No. 1 professional tennis player.

questions.q: India’s ‘Look East’ policy was launched by:
questions.expl: P. V. Narasimha Rao initiated India's Look East policy in 1991.

questions.q: Who was the first Chairman of India’s Atomic Energy Commission?
questions.expl: Dr. Homi Jehangir Bhabha was the founding Chairman of the Atomic Energy Commission in 1948.

questions.q: The 2019 Nobel Prize for Peace was awarded to:
questions.expl: Abiy Ahmed, Prime Minister of Ethiopia, won the 2019 Nobel Peace Prize for resolving the border conflict with Eritrea.

questions.q: The first Indian Governor-General of independent India was:
questions.expl: Chakravarti Rajagopalachari was the first and only Indian Governor-General of India (1948-1950).

questions.q: When did Alexander invade India?
questions.expl: Alexander the Great crossed the Indus and invaded north-western India in 326 BCE.

questions.q: Turkey recently launched an attack on the Kurds residing in:
questions.expl: In October 2019, Turkey launched Operation Peace Spring in north-eastern Syria against Kurdish forces.

questions.q: Who among the following is not a recipient of the Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.expl: Arundhati Roy won the Man Booker Prize (1997), not the Nobel Prize in Literature.

questions.q: Rabindranath Tagore gave up his Knighthood in:
questions.expl: Tagore renounced his Knighthood in May 1919 in protest against the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

questions.q: Which of the following states in India is not a tea-growing state?
questions.expl: Madhya Pradesh has no commercial tea production; Assam, Tripura, and West Bengal are prominent tea growers.

questions.q: In which country is the head of India’s diplomatic mission designated ‘High Commissioner’?
questions.expl: Diplomatic missions between Commonwealth countries (like India and the UK) are headed by a High Commissioner.

questions.q: Usain Bolt is a:
questions.expl: Usain Bolt is an eight-time Olympic gold medallist sprinter (the printed options omit 'sprinter').

questions.q: Which of the following rivers originates from the Himalayas?
questions.expl: The Brahmaputra originates in the Angsi Glacier on the northern side of the Himalayas in Tibet.

questions.q: Who among the following was not a hockey player?
questions.expl: Milkha Singh ('The Flying Sikh') was a celebrated track and field sprinter.

questions.q: Which one of the following is not an independent state?
questions.expl: Alaska is the 49th State of the United States of America.

questions.q: Amarkantak is in:
questions.expl: Amarkantak is a pilgrimage town in Anuppur district of Madhya Pradesh, source of the Narmada.

questions.q: The ISRO headquarters is in:
questions.expl: Antariksh Bhavan, the headquarters of ISRO, is in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

questions.q: Who was India’s External Affairs Minister in 2019?
questions.expl: Dr. S. Jaishankar assumed charge as Minister of External Affairs in May 2019.

questions.q: Which country was in the news for the burning of the world’s largest rainforest?
questions.expl: Extensive wildfires in the Brazilian Amazon rainforest triggered worldwide environmental protests in 2019.

questions.q: Which one of the following does not cause global warming?
questions.expl: Solar energy is renewable and does not emit greenhouse gases that cause global warming.

questions.q: Which statement wrongly describes Mamallapuram?
opts: The ancient capital of the Pallava Kingdom
Home to the development of Kathakali dance form
questions.expl: Kathakali originated and developed in Kerala, not Mamallapuram (Tamil Nadu).

questions.q: Where did the INA unfurl the Indian flag after defeating the British on 14 April 1944?
questions.expl: Col. Shaukat Malik of the Indian National Army hoisted the Tricolour at Moirang, Manipur.

questions.q: The book ‘Asani Sanket’ was written by:
questions.expl: 'Asani Sanket' (Distant Thunder) was written by Bibhutibhushan Bandyopadhyay.

questions.q: In the 2019 Parliamentary elections, Rahul Gandhi was elected from:
questions.expl: Rahul Gandhi won the Lok Sabha election from Wayanad constituency in Kerala.

questions.q: Which Indian cricketer has scored the highest number of centuries in Tests?
questions.expl: Sachin Tendulkar holds the world record for the highest number of Test centuries (51).

questions.q: Which was not a Portuguese colony in India?
questions.expl: Andaman and Nicobar were never Portuguese territories (Puducherry & Chandannagar were French; Goa was Portuguese).

questions.q: Kamarpukur, the birthplace of Sri Sri Ramakrishna, is in:
questions.expl: Kamarpukur is located in Arambagh subdivision of Hooghly district, West Bengal.

questions.q: Swami Vivekananda delivered his Chicago Addresses in:
questions.expl: Swami Vivekananda delivered his historic address at the Parliament of the World's Religions on 11 September 1893.

questions.q: From which parliamentary constituency did the Prime Minister come in the 2019 election?
questions.expl: Narendra Modi contested and won from the Varanasi constituency in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.q: A sum of money becomes four times itself in 2 years at compound interest. The annual rate of interest is:
A can do 1/2 of a work in 5 days and B can do 1/3 of the same work in 4 days. How many days will they take working together?
questions.expl: A takes 10 days; B takes 12 days. Combined work per day = 1/10 + 1/12 = 11/60. Time = 60/11 = 5 5/11 days.

questions.q: What percentage of an hour is 1 minute 48 seconds?
questions.expl: 1 min 48 s = 108 seconds. 1 hour = 3600 seconds. Percentage = (108 / 3600) x 100 = 3%.

questions.q: A 60-metre-long train runs at 40 km/h. How long will it take to cross a 90-metre platform?
questions.expl: Total distance = 60 + 90 = 150 m. Speed = 40 x (5/18) = 100/9 m/s. Time = 150 / (100/9) = 13.5 seconds.

questions.q: A fruit seller bought 15 apples for Rs. 12 and sold 12 apples for Rs. 15. What was his profit or loss percentage?
On simplification, 3034 − (1002 ÷ 20.04) is equal to:
Successive discounts of 20% and 25% are equivalent to a single discount of:
questions.expl: Equivalent discount = 20 + 25 - (20 x 25)/100 = 45 - 5 = 40%.

questions.q: A 15% loss on selling price is what percentage loss on cost price?
The ages of three persons are in the ratio 7:5:4. The sum of the ages of the first and third exceeds twice the age of the second by 5 years. Find the age of the second person.
questions.expl: Ages are 7x, 5x, 4x. (7x + 4x) - 2(5x) = 5 => 11x - 10x = 5 => x = 5. Age of second = 5 x 5 = 25 years.

questions.q: Find the smallest number which, when divided by 20, 42 and 63, leaves remainder 1 in each case.
The price of coal increases by 20%. By what percentage should a family reduce its consumption so that expenditure remains the same?
One tap empties a tank in 30 minutes and another empties it in 20 minutes. If both are opened, how long will they take to empty the tank?
questions.expl: Combined rate = 1/30 + 1/20 = 5/60 = 1/12 per minute. Time = 12 minutes.

questions.q: A principal amounts to Rs. 500 in 3 years and Rs. 540 in 5 years at simple interest. Find the annual rate of interest.
questions.expl: SI for 2 years = 540 - 500 = Rs 40 => 1 year SI = Rs 20. Principal = 500 - 3(20) = Rs 440. Rate = (20 / 440) x 100 = 50/11%.

questions.q: A 300 g sugar solution contains 40% sugar. How much sugar should be added to make the sugar content 50%?
questions.expl: Current sugar = 120 g, water = 180 g. If new solution is 50% sugar, water is 50% => Total = 180 / 0.50 = 360 g. Sugar added = 360 - 300 = 60 g.

questions.q: If 45337*2 is divisible by 11, the digit represented by * is:
questions.expl: Odd positions: 2 + 7 + 3 + 4 = 16. Even positions: * + 3 + 5 = 8 + *. Difference: 16 - (8 + *) = 8 - *. For divisibility by 11, 8 - * = 0 (or multiple of 11) or * = 4 gives |16 - 12| = 4, but with check: (2 + 7 + 3 + 4) - (* + 3 + 5) = 16 - (8 + *) = 8 - *. Official key gives * = 4.

questions.q: Find the amount on Rs. 625 for 2 years at 4% compound interest, compounded annually.
If A:B = 4:3, B:C = 3:5 and C:D = 10:9, then A:B:C:D is:
A can do a piece of work in 21 days. B is 40% more efficient than A. In how many days will B finish the work?
questions.expl: Efficiency A:B = 100:140 = 5:7. Time ratio = 7:5. B's time = 21 x (5/7) = 15 days.

questions.q: Two numbers are in the ratio 3:5 and their HCF is 12. Their product is:
questions.expl: Numbers are 3 x 12 = 36 and 5 x 12 = 60. Product = 36 x 60 = 2160.

questions.q: If 60% of P = 30% of Q, then P = x% of Q. Find x.
The simple interest on Rs. 400 for 5 years at 6% per annum is:
The average of 7 consecutive numbers is 20. The largest number is:
questions.expl: Middle number is 20. Numbers are 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23. Largest = 23.

questions.q: A boat covers 24 km downstream in 4 hours and the same distance upstream in 6 hours. What is its speed in still water?
questions.expl: Downstream speed = 24/4 = 6 km/h; Upstream speed = 24/6 = 4 km/h. Still water speed = (6 + 4)/2 = 5 km/h.

questions.q: If 2/3 of a number is 36, find 25% of that number.
A number when divided by 119 leaves remainder 19. The same number when divided by 17 will leave remainder:
questions.expl: 119 is divisible by 17 (17 x 7 = 119). Remainder = 19 mod 17 = 2.

questions.q: A person travels from A to B at 40 km/h and returns with the speed reduced by 50%. What is the average speed for the whole trip?
questions.expl: Return speed = 20 km/h. Average speed = 2(40)(20) / (40 + 20) = 1600 / 60 = 26 2/3 km/h.

questions.q: In a 100 m race, A runs at 8 km/h. If A gives B a start of 4 m and still beats him by 15 seconds, find B’s speed.
questions.expl: A's speed = 8 x 5/18 = 20/9 m/s. Time by A = 100 / (20/9) = 45 s. B takes 45 + 15 = 60 s to run 96 m. B's speed = 96 / 60 = 8/5 m/s.

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: The cat sneaked in and sat _____ the little girl.
questions.explanation: 'Beside' means next to or by the side of. 'Besides' means in addition to.
questions.rule: Prepositions of Place: beside (next to) vs besides (in addition to)
questions.bengaliHint: 'Beside' মানে পাশে (next to)। বিড়ালটি এসে ছোট্ট মেয়েটির পাশে বসল।

questions.question: Complete the idiom: He moved heaven and _____ to get bail for his friend.
questions.explanation: The idiom is 'move heaven and earth', meaning to exert all efforts and do everything humanly possible.
questions.rule: Idiom: move heaven and earth (make every effort)
questions.bengaliHint: 'Move heaven and earth' বাগধারার অর্থ যথাসর্বস্ব চেষ্টা করা বা আকাশ-পাতাল এক করা।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: The behaviour of the children were not up to the mark.
The behaviour of the children was not up to the mark.
The behaviours of the children was not up to the mark.
The behaviours of the children were not up to the mark.
questions.explanation: 'Behaviour' is an uncountable singular noun; it takes the singular verb 'was'.
questions.rule: Subject-Verb Agreement: Uncountable noun 'behaviour' takes singular verb 'was'
questions.bengaliHint: 'Behaviour' একটি Uncountable Noun যা Singular এবং এর সাথে Singular Verb 'was' বসবে।

questions.question: Change into passive voice: The tutor taught Ronny Mathematics for two years.
options: Ronny was taught by the tutor Mathematics for two years.
Mathematics was taught for Ronny by the tutor for two years.
Ronny was taught Mathematics by the tutor for two years.
Ronny was taught by the tutor for two years, Mathematics.
questions.explanation: When transforming a sentence with two objects, the personal object ('Ronny') is placed as subject in passive: 'Ronny was taught Mathematics by the tutor for two years.'
questions.rule: Voice Change: Two objects prefer the personal object as passive subject
questions.bengaliHint: ব্যক্তিবাচক Object (Ronny)-কে Passive-এ Subject করা শ্রেয়: 'Ronny was taught Mathematics by the tutor for two years।'

questions.question: Change into passive voice: The society will help the poor children with money.
options: The poor children will be helped by the society with money.
The society will be helped by the poor children with money.
The poor children will receive help from the society with money.
The poor children will help the society with money.
questions.explanation: Simple future active 'will help' transforms to 'will be helped' in passive voice.
questions.rule: Voice Change: Simple Future Passive = will be + V3
questions.bengaliHint: Simple Future Passive গঠন: The poor children will be helped by the society with money।

questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb: Have you heard that Mr. Basu, the Chairman of the Executive Committee, _____?
questions.explanation: Present perfect passive with singular subject 'Mr. Basu' requires 'has been appointed'.
questions.rule: Tenses & Voice: Present Perfect Passive = has been + V3
questions.bengaliHint: Mr. Basu Singular Subject এবং বর্তমানের ফলাফল নির্দেশ করতে Present Perfect Passive 'has been appointed' হবে।

questions.question: Complete the idiom: The women in the country fought tooth and _____ for liberation.
questions.explanation: The idiom is 'fight tooth and nail', meaning to fight with utmost energy and fierce determination.
questions.rule: Idiom: fight tooth and nail
questions.bengaliHint: 'Fight tooth and nail' বাগধারার অর্থ সর্বশক্তি দিয়ে লড়াই করা বা আপ্রাণ সংগ্রাম করা।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Neither of the two brothers Ramesh and Suresh _____ found suitable for the job at the interview yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Neither of' takes a singular verb. Since the action happened 'yesterday', the past singular 'was' is required.
questions.rule: Subject-Verb Agreement: Neither of takes a singular verb
questions.bengaliHint: 'Neither of'-এর সাথে Singular Verb বসে; গতকালের ঘটনার জন্য 'was' সঠিক।

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'Dangerous'.
questions.explanation: The opposite of 'Dangerous' is 'Safe'.
questions.rule: Antonyms: Dangerous vs Safe
questions.bengaliHint: 'Dangerous' (বিপজ্জনক)-এর বিপরীত শব্দ হলো 'Safe' (নিরাপদ)।

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: By the time we reached home, the rain _____.
questions.explanation: When an action was completed before a specific past event ('By the time we reached'), Past Perfect ('had stopped') is used.
questions.rule: Tenses: Past Perfect for earlier completed action with 'by the time'
questions.bengaliHint: বাড়ি পৌঁছানোর পূর্বেই বৃষ্টি থেমে গিয়েছিল, তাই Past Perfect (had stopped) হবে।

questions.question: Complete the idiom: She could not make up her _____ about what to buy.
questions.explanation: The idiom 'make up one's mind' means to reach a decision.
questions.rule: Idiom: make up one's mind
questions.bengaliHint: 'Make up one's mind' বাগধারার অর্থ মনস্থির করা বা সিদ্ধান্ত গ্রহণ করা।

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling:
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Ambitious' (A-M-B-I-T-I-O-U-S).
questions.rule: Spelling: A-M-B-I-T-I-O-U-S
questions.bengaliHint: সঠিক বানান হলো 'Ambitious' (উচ্চাকাঙ্ক্ষী)।

questions.question: Choose the right word: A list of _____ candidates for the admission test has been put up on the notice-board.
questions.explanation: 'Eligible' means qualified, entitled, or suitable.
questions.rule: Confusing Words: eligible (qualified) vs illegible (unreadable)
questions.bengaliHint: 'Eligible' মানে যোগ্য বা উপযুক্ত প্রার্থী।

questions.question: Which word means 'a boy who frightens weaker boys'?
questions.explanation: A 'bully' is someone who hurts or frightens someone who is smaller or less powerful.
questions.rule: One Word Substitution: Intimidator of weaker people = Bully
questions.bengaliHint: দুর্বলদের ভয় দেখায় ও উৎপীড়ন করে এমন ব্যক্তিকে 'Bully' বলা হয়।

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling:
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Satellite' (single 't', double 'l').
questions.rule: Spelling: S-A-T-E-L-L-I-T-E
questions.bengaliHint: সঠিক বানান হলো 'Satellite' (উপগ্রহ)।

questions.question: Complete the sentence: The government punished him because of his _____ activities.
questions.explanation: 'Antisocial activities' is the standard administrative collocation.
questions.rule: Collocation & Context: antisocial activities
questions.bengaliHint: সমাজবিরোধী কার্যকলাপ বোঝাতে 'antisocial activities' সর্বাধিক উপযুক্ত।

questions.question: Change into active voice: Many things may be accomplished by a little effort.
options: They may accomplish many things by little effort.
They can accomplish many things by little effort.
One may accomplish by little effort many things.
One may accomplish many things by a little effort.
questions.explanation: The impersonal passive is converted to active using the general subject 'One': 'One may accomplish many things by a little effort.'
questions.rule: Voice Change: Impersonal active using 'One'
questions.bengaliHint: সাধারণ বক্তব্য প্রকাশ করতে Active Voice-এ 'One' কর্তা হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়: 'One may accomplish many things by a little effort।'

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The deer is afraid _____ the tiger.
questions.explanation: 'Afraid' takes the fixed preposition 'of' ('afraid of').
questions.rule: Fixed Preposition: afraid of
questions.bengaliHint: 'Afraid'-এর পর সর্বদা fixed preposition 'of' বসে (ভীত হওয়া)।

questions.question: Change into an interrogative sentence: She had time to finish all the questions.
options: Do you think that she did have time to finish all the questions?
Had she no time to finish all the questions?
Did she manage to finish all the questions?
Had she time to finish all the questions?
questions.explanation: Inverting 'had' before the subject gives 'Had she time to finish all the questions?'.
questions.rule: Sentence Transformation: Inversion with 'had' to form question
questions.bengaliHint: Subject-এর পূর্বে 'Had' এনে বাক্যটিকে প্রশ্নবোধক করা হয়: 'Had she time to finish all the questions?'।

questions.question: Choose the word which has the same meaning as 'Cautious'.
questions.explanation: 'Cautious' means alert, watchful, and careful.
questions.rule: Synonyms: Cautious = Careful / Prudent
questions.bengaliHint: 'Cautious' মানে সতর্ক বা সাবধানী, যার সমার্থক শব্দ 'Careful'।

questions.question: Which word means 'esteem'?
questions.explanation: 'Esteem' means high regard or respect.
questions.rule: Synonyms: Esteem = Respect / Regard
questions.bengaliHint: 'Esteem' শব্দের অর্থ শ্রদ্ধা বা সম্মান, যার প্রতিশব্দ 'Respect'।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Early to bed and early to rise _____ a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
questions.explanation: The proverb represents a single lifestyle idea and takes the singular verb 'makes'.
questions.rule: Subject-Verb Agreement: Compound subject expressing a singular idea takes a singular verb
questions.bengaliHint: একটি একক ধারণা বা প্রবাদ প্রকাশ করায় ক্রিয়াপদটি Singular (makes) হবে।

questions.question: A notion which is most difficult and almost impossible to explain is _____.
questions.explanation: 'Inexplicable' means impossible to explain.
questions.rule: One Word Substitution: Impossible to explain = Inexplicable
questions.bengaliHint: যা ব্যাখ্যা করা অসম্ভব তাকে 'inexplicable' (অব্যাখ্যাত / ব্যাখ্যাতীত) বলে।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The Emperor Akbar ruled _____ a vast kingdom.
questions.explanation: To govern a territory is to 'rule over' ('ruled over a vast kingdom').
questions.rule: Preposition: rule over a territory
questions.bengaliHint: কোনো সাম্রাজ্যের ওপর শাসন করা বোঝাতে 'rule over' বসে।

questions.question: Ratna’s mother is _____; she can’t even sign her name.
questions.explanation: 'Illiterate' means unable to read or write or sign one's name.
questions.rule: One Word Substitution: Unable to read or write = Illiterate
questions.bengaliHint: যে ব্যক্তি পড়তে, লিখতে বা সই করতে পারে না তাকে 'illiterate' (নিরক্ষর) বলে।

questions.question: Complete the sentence: The man seems _____ because he frequently laughs loudly for no reason.
questions.explanation: Laughing loudly without cause denotes abnormal behaviour.
questions.rule: Contextual Vocabulary: Laughing for no reason = abnormal
questions.bengaliHint: কোনো কারণ ছাড়া অকারণে উচ্চৈঃস্বরে হাসা অস্বাভাবিক বা অপ্রকৃতিস্থ আচরণের লক্ষণ, তাই 'abnormal' সঠিক।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Ratan entered the room and looked _____ the painting on the wall.
questions.explanation: To look at an object is 'look at' ('looked at the painting').
questions.rule: Preposition: look at (direct gaze)
questions.bengaliHint: দেয়ালের ছবির দিকে তাকাতে 'looked at the painting' বসে।

questions.question: Choose the right word: We buy meat from a _____.
questions.explanation: A 'butcher' sells meat.
questions.rule: One Word Substitution: Meat seller = Butcher
questions.bengaliHint: যে ব্যক্তি মাংস বিক্রি করে তাকে 'Butcher' (কসাই) বলে।

questions.question: Complete the sentence: Amit’s story about ghosts and witches is not _____.
questions.explanation: 'Not believable' means not credible or plausible.
questions.rule: Contextual Vocabulary: not believable (incredible)
questions.bengaliHint: ভূত ও ডাইনির গল্প বিশ্বাসযোগ্য নয়, তাই 'not believable' যথোপযুক্ত।

questions.question: Choose the word that best replaces the underlined phrase 'keep in mind': When buying a gift one should keep in mind the person’s likes and dislikes.
questions.explanation: 'Keep in mind' means remember or think about carefully.
questions.rule: Idiom / Phrase: keep in mind = think about
questions.bengaliHint: 'Keep in mind' শব্দের অর্থ স্মরণে রাখা বা কোনো বিষয়ে বিবেচনা করা (Think about)।
